releaseNotes: Pairing a premium service or tracker (Simkl, Trakt, WeTrakr, MDBList) now shows a QR code next to the address and code, and a service that does not answer the first time is retried automatically. HazMat TV is now built the Starfleet way: Home with widgets (highlight Movies, TV Shows, Live TV, Anime, Sports, Radio or Settings to see its widgets), autoplay trailers in English, Continue Watching, Favorites (on your profile or a TMDB list), cast with photos (open an actor to see everything they have been in), release and air dates, certification and the content advisory. Pair premium services and your trackers (Simkl, Trakt, WeTrakr, MDBList) in Settings; IPTV movies and shows are a source on every title and listed under IPTV Movies / IPTV TV Shows. Profiles, My Teams alerts (including the FloHockey leagues), split screen (side by side or top and bottom, mixing IPTV, movies and live sports), and Left / Right now skip back and forward during playback. Your IPTV providers, debrid pairings and trackers carry over from the old version. Needs Android 7 or newer.
